subject: def
title: (R)DEF.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 236 (T(IMP)M-34). DEF (definition) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), INDIV-VT-TD and PART (participation). From VT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: MOT-DY. From INDIV-VT-TD: IST-F-ACT and SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P: INFO-ALGN (information alignment). From INFO-ALGN: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From CULT-INFO-B: MD-DY (media dynamics). From PART: OPT-SD and CULT-O (culture order).
